label: Pro 2.1.0
title: Know what changed, where your team reads
lede: Pro 2.1.0 adds a Consent Mode check to the scanner, a Tag Manager container for the default consent state, and team alerts that name the new findings from your weekly monitor run.

items.title: Alerts in Slack or Teams
items.text: The weekly monitor posts one message per run that names the new findings per site, with those active before consent first. It runs in your own GitHub account and sends only site names and finding names to the webhook you set.
items.code:
PERMITO_ALERT_WEBHOOK = <incoming webhook URL of Slack or Teams>

# any URL that accepts a POST with {"text": "..."} works

items.title: Consent Mode check
items.text: The scanner reads the consent state (gcs, gcd) that Google tags send before any interaction. Tags that run granted or without a consent state show up as findings of the type consentMode.

items.title: Tag Manager container
items.text: One command writes an importable Tag Manager container that sets the default consent state on Consent Initialization, before every other tag.

items.title: Finding keys in the report
items.text: summary.json lists findingKeys per site, and the monitor stores them in each issue. That is how it can tell you what is new, not just that something changed.

note: The demo cannot show the alerts or the monitor: they run in your own GitHub account with your webhook. The Consent Mode check and the Tag Manager container are beta; the container has not yet been imported into a real Tag Manager account.
